comment: Every MIME type an Android content provider might use for an archive.
This list is read by three things that must never disagree: the file picker
(src/archive/pick.ts), the 'Open with' intent filter that the config plugin
writes into AndroidManifest.xml, and the share filter built in
app.config.js. When the first two drifted apart, a .rar on the phone
appeared greyed out in the picker AND EzUnpack was missing from the Open
with list, from a single missing entry.
'pickerExtras' goes to the picker and the share sheet but NOT to Open with.
Both of the first two are things the user started, so an extra row costs
them a scroll; Open with is unsolicited, and octet-stream there would make
EzUnpack volunteer for every unrecognised file on the phone.
There is no authoritative spelling. Samsung's MediaStore reports .rar as
'application/rar'; other providers use 'application/vnd.rar' or
'application/x-rar-compressed' for the same file. Anything unidentified
arrives as 'application/octet-stream', which is why that stays in the list
even though it also matches unrelated files: a visible-but-untappable
archive stops the user dead, while a few extra rows only ask them to scroll.
Verify additions against a real device before trusting them:
adb shell content query --uri content://media/external/file \
--projection _display_name:mime_type --where "_display_name LIKE '%.rar'"
